notes: Building and Engineering News, vol. 22 part 2 (Internet Archive buildingengineer2222cont), the 27 weekly issues from 1 July to 30 December 1922. Same method as the later volumes: every numbered entry under Building Permit Applications and Building Contracts was taken from the djvu.xml OCR, East Bay headings set aside, and each San Francisco lot built from the block corner on the DPW street centrelines and compared with the sf-parcels shapes; a placement was accepted where the lot starts within two feet of a lot line of today (or the record names an unambiguous corner) and the roll dates the building 1921-1924, and alterations were matched by printed street number in sf-eas-addresses where the roll dates the building before 1922. Every published row was read against the page image, location first; 132 of the 211 rows read needed a name, a cost or the wording corrected, and a cost or name that could not be read on the image was left out (where the crop shows only the heading, only the heading is published). Descriptions of rows marked confidence low were built from the OCR and have not been read against the image. Owners are private individuals and are cut everywhere (raw.note; scrub_owner.py removes the fragments the OCR garbles past the first cut); a firm or institution named as owner is kept, and where the contractor, architect or engineer named is the owner or shares the owner's surname at the owner's address that name is cut too. Sub-trade contracts are timeline entries and set no builder credit. Completion notices, liens, sub-contracts printed 'on above' and the news columns were not taken. Issue dates are set from the dated running heads, 27 issues one week apart with no gap. Permits whose heading counts more than one dwelling (19) were set aside before the image check and sit with the held single houses, as do nine houses that were read against the image: three more from rows of houses and six single houses with no architect left to name once the owner-builder was cut. Five held rows whose parcel got a page from another fact in this volume were read against the image and published; a sixth stays held as a repeat listing.

coverage.remaining: Vols. 22 part 2 to 31 read (July 1922 to January 1932); the 15 half-year volumes before July 1922 (1915 to June 1922) are unread, vol. 22 part 1 (January-June 1922, buildingengineer222cont) next. In this volume: 210 rows placed on a parcel whose roll year fits, single houses with no architect named and no page (22 of them permits for a row of houses), are logged and held until another fact gives the parcel a page (extra.placed_apn; all but ten still need the image check). 317 rows have a nearest parcel that was not accepted (the lot starts off today's lot lines, or the roll dates the building outside the window). 786 rows were not placed: location lines not parsed (tract lots, garbled headings), street pairs that do not cross under the names read, and printed street numbers with no EAS row today.
coverage.note: 2,782 numbered entries read, 1,519 San Francisco rows, 733 placed on a parcel, 211 picked and read against the page image, 174 published on 159 pages (89 seeded), 32 held back: twenty-six uses, storeys or unit counts that contradict the roll, two alterations listed by lot line with nothing to confirm the street number, one repeat listing, one misread street number, one retaining wall and one fact for a whole building whose only page is a condominium unit; nine more joined the held houses.
